parsed.note_claim: Medieval Europeans washed regularly in bathhouses, basins, and rivers.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In the Middle Ages, bathing commonly took place in public bathhouses. Public bathing was common in larger towns and cities such as Paris, Regensburg and Naples.
parsed.reason: The text explicitly confirms that public bathing was common in Medieval Europe, directly substantiating the note's claim about medieval bathing habits.
